requirement: Data Fiduciaries must provide a fair account of details necessary for specific and informed consent in clear and plain language.
checkable_test: Verify if the document specifies the requirement to provide a fair account of details in clear and plain language for informed consent as per the referenced section.
applicability: Applicable to Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: Provide a clear and accessible communication link for accessing the website or app.
checkable_test: Verify the presence of a specific and accessible link to the website or app in the document.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries required to provide such links.

requirement: Provide a description of means for withdrawing consent with ease comparable to the ease of giving consent.
checkable_test: Verify the presence of a clear and accessible method for withdrawing consent.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries requiring consent.

requirement: Provide a description of means for making a complaint to the Board.
checkable_test: Verify the presence of a clear and accessible method for lodging a complaint with the Board.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries.

requirement: Register as a Consent Manager with the Board by furnishing required particulars and documents.
checkable_test: Verify the presence of a registration process for Consent Managers as per the Board's requirements.
applicability: Applicable to entities registering as Consent Managers.

requirement: Register the applicant as a Consent Manager and publish the details on the Board's website.
checkable_test: Verify the presence of a process for registering Consent Managers and publishing their details.
applicability: Applicable to entities registering as Consent Managers.

requirement: Ensure Consent Managers adhere to conditions and obligations as specified in Part B of the First Schedule.
checkable_test: Verify the presence of obligations for Consent Managers as specified in Part B of the First Schedule.
applicability: Applicable to all Consent Managers.

requirement: Take corrective measures if the Board identifies nonadherence to conditions and obligations by a Consent Manager.
checkable_test: Verify the presence of a process for addressing nonadherence by Consent Managers.
applicability: Applicable to all Consent Managers.

requirement: Issue an order for reasons to be recorded in writing if it is necessary to act in the interests of Data Principals.
checkable_test: Verify the presence of a process for issuing orders in the interests of Data Principals.
applicability: Applicable to all Consent Managers.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must implement reasonable security safeguards to protect personal data in its possession or under its control, including any processing undertaken by it or on its behalf.
checkable_test: Check if the document explicitly states that the organization implements reasonable security safeguards to protect personal data.
applicability: Applicable to all Data Fiduciaries handling personal data.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the requirement for reasonable security safeguards under the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: Implement appropriate data security measures, such as encryption, obfuscation, masking, or the use of virtual tokens mapped to personal data.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies encryption, obfuscation, masking, or virtual tokens for securing personal data.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries and processors handling personal data.

requirement: Implement appropriate measures to control access to computer resources used by the data fiduciary or data processor.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies access control measures for computer resources.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries and processors handling personal data.

requirement: Maintain visibility on the accessing of personal data through appropriate logs, monitoring, and review to detect unauthorized access.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies logging, monitoring, and review mechanisms for detecting unauthorized access.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries and processors handling personal data.

requirement: Implement reasonable measures for continued processing in the event of confidentiality, integrity, or availability of personal data being compromised, such as data-backups.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies data-backup or continuity measures for data compromise.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries and processors handling personal data.

requirement: Retain logs and personal data for a period of one year for detecting unauthorized access, investigating it, and ensuring continued processing, unless required by law.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies a one-year retention period for logs and personal data for security purposes.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries and processors handling personal data.

requirement: Include appropriate provisions in contracts between data fiduciaries and data processors for taking reasonable security safeguards.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies contractual provisions for security safeguards between data fiduciaries and processors.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries and processors handling personal data.

requirement: Implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure effective observance of security safeguards.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies technical and organizational measures for security safeguards.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries and processors handling personal data.

requirement: Data Fiduciary must notify affected Data Principals of personal data breaches in a concise, clear, and plain manner without delay.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the obligation to notify affected Data Principals of personal data breaches in a clear and timely manner.
applicability: Applicable to all Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation under DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 8(1).

requirement: Data Fiduciary must provide a description of the breach, including its nature, extent, and timing of occurrence.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the obligation to provide a detailed description of the breach, including its nature, extent, and timing.
applicability: Applicable to all Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation under DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 8(1).

requirement: Data Fiduciary must inform affected Data Principals of the consequences likely to arise from the breach.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the obligation to inform affected Data Principals of the consequences likely to arise from the breach.
applicability: Applicable to all Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation under DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 8(1).

requirement: Data Fiduciary must provide affected Data Principals with safety measures to protect their interests.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the obligation to provide affected Data Principals with safety measures to protect their interests.
applicability: Applicable to all Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation under DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 8(1).

requirement: Data Fiduciary must notify the Board of personal data breaches without delay.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the obligation to notify the Board of personal data breaches without delay.
applicability: Applicable to all Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation under DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 8(1).

requirement: Data Fiduciary must provide a detailed description of the breach, including its nature, extent, timing, location, and likely impact.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the obligation to provide a detailed description of the breach, including its nature, extent, timing, location, and likely impact.
applicability: Applicable to all Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation under DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 8(1).

requirement: Data Fiduciary must notify the Board of personal data breaches within seventy-two hours of becoming aware of the breach, or within a longer period as specified.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the obligation to notify the Board of personal data breaches within seventy-two hours of becoming aware of the breach, or within a longer period as specified.
applicability: Applicable to all Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation under DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 8(1).

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must erase personal data upon completion of the specified retention period unless retention is necessary for legal compliance.
checkable_test: Verify if the Data Fiduciary provides a mechanism for erasure of personal data after the retention period, unless retention is required by law.
applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries processing personal data for specified purposes.
notes: This obligation is tied to the retention period and legal necessity for retention.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must inform the Data Principal of the erasure of personal data at least 48 hours before completion of the retention period, unless the Data Principal initiates contact.
checkable_test: Verify if the Data Fiduciary provides a notice of erasure at least 48 hours before the end of the retention period, unless the Data Principal contacts them.
applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries processing personal data for specified purposes.
notes: This obligation is tied to the notification requirement before erasure.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary shall retain personal data, associated traffic data, and other logs of processing for a minimum period of one year from the date of processing, unless further retention is required for compliance with any other law.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies a one-year retention period for personal data and logs of processing, with exceptions for legal compliance.
applicability: Applies to all data fiduciaries processing personal data.
notes: This obligation is explicitly stated in Rule 8(3) of the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary shall ensure that a Data Processor also retains data and associated logs for at least one year before erasure, unless any other applicable law requires a longer period.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies that data processors must retain data and logs for at least one year, with exceptions for legal compliance.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries who engage data processors.
notes: This obligation is explicitly stated in Rule 8(3) of the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary shall prominently publish on its website or app, and mention in every response to a communication for the exercise of the rights of a Data Principal under the Act, the business contact information of the Data Fiduciary.
checkable_test: Check if the document provides prominent contact information for the data fiduciary in response to data principal communications.
applicability: Applies to all data fiduciaries.
notes: This obligation is explicitly stated in Rule 8(9) of the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: Every Data Fiduciary shall prominently publish on its website or app, and mention in every response to a communication for the exercise of the rights of a Data Principal under the Act, the contact information of the Data Protection Officer, if applicable, or a person who is able to answer on behalf of the Data Fiduciary the questions of the Data Principal about the processing of her personal data.
checkable_test: Check if the document provides prominent contact information for the data protection officer or a representative in response to data principal communications.
applicability: Applies to all data fiduciaries.
notes: This obligation is explicitly stated in Rule 8(9) of the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary shall adopt appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure that verifiable consent of the parent is obtained before the processing of any personal data of a child.
checkable_test: Check if the document requires verifiable consent from a parent before processing personal data of a child.
applicability: Applies to all data fiduciaries processing personal data of children.
notes: This obligation is explicitly stated in Rule 8(10)(1) of the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary shall observe due diligence, for checking that the individual identifying herself as the parent is an adult who is identifiable if required in connection with compliance with any law for the time being in force in India, by reference to reliable details of identity and age of the individual available with the Data Fiduciary; or details of identity and age, voluntarily provided.
checkable_test: Check if the document requires due diligence to verify the identity and age of the parent before processing personal data of a child.
applicability: Applies to all data fiduciaries processing personal data of children.
notes: This obligation is explicitly stated in Rule 8(10)(1) of the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must verify that a parent or guardian is an identifiable adult before processing the personal data of a child.
checkable_test: Check if the platform verifies the identity and age of the parent/guardian through government-issued details or a digital locker service provider before creating a child's account.
applicability: Applicable when processing personal data of a child.
notes: This requirement is specific to the creation of user accounts for children and involves verification of the parent's identity and age.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must verify that a lawful guardian of a person with disability is appointed by a court of law, designated authority, or local level committee.
checkable_test: Check if the platform verifies the legal appointment of the guardian through court, authority, or committee documentation.
applicability: Applicable when processing personal data of a person with disability who has a lawful guardian.
notes: This requirement ensures that the guardian has legal authority to consent to data processing on behalf of the person with disability.

requirement: Significant Data Fiduciaries must not apply sub-sections (1) and (3) of section 9 of the Act to processing of personal data of a child, unless specified in Part A of Fourth Schedule.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies exemptions for processing children's data under Part A of Fourth Schedule.
applicability: Applicable to processing of personal data of children by specified Data Fiduciaries.

requirement: Significant Data Fiduciaries must not apply sub-sections (1) and (3) of section 9 of the Act to processing of personal data of a child for purposes specified in Part B of Fourth Schedule, unless conditions are met.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies exemptions for processing children's data for purposes in Part B of Fourth Schedule.
applicability: Applicable to processing of personal data of children for specified purposes.

requirement: Significant Data Fiduciaries must undertake a Data Protection Impact Assessment and an audit to ensure compliance with the Act and rules.
checkable_test: Check if the document requires a Data Protection Impact Assessment and audit for compliance.
applicability: Applicable to all Significant Data Fiduciaries.

requirement: Significant Data Fiduciaries must ensure that reports from Data Protection Impact Assessments and audits are submitted to the Board.
checkable_test: Check if the document requires submission of reports from Data Protection Impact Assessments and audits to the Board.
applicability: Applicable to Significant Data Fiduciaries.

requirement: Significant Data Fiduciaries must ensure that technical measures, including algorithmic software, used for processing personal data do not pose risks to Data Principals' rights.
checkable_test: Check if the document requires verification that technical measures used for processing personal data do not pose risks to Data Principals' rights.
applicability: Applicable to Significant Data Fiduciaries.

requirement: Central Government may restrict transfer of personal data and traffic data outside India, subject to recommendations of a committee.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies restrictions on transferring personal data and traffic data outside India.
applicability: Applicable to data processing involving transfer of personal data and traffic data.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must prominently publish information on their website or app to enable Data Principals to exercise their rights under the Act.
checkable_test: Check if the document requires prominent publication of information to enable Data Principals to exercise their rights.
applicability: Applicable to all Data Fiduciaries.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must provide Data Principals with details of the means to exercise their rights under the Act.
checkable_test: Check if the document provides clear, accessible means for Data Principals to exercise their rights.
applicability: Applicable to all Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation to provide means for exercising rights.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must specify the particulars required to identify Data Principals when exercising their rights.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the required identification details for Data Principals to exercise their rights.
applicability: Applicable to all Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation to specify identification details for exercising rights.

requirement: Data Principals may make requests to the Data Fiduciary to whom they have previously given consent for processing of their personal data, using the means and furnishing the particulars required by such Data Fiduciary for the exercise of such rights.
checkable_test: Check if the document allows Data Principals to make requests to Data Fiduciaries using the required means and identification details.
applicability: Applicable to all Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation to allow Data Principals to make requests using required means and identification details.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries and Consent Managers must prominently publish on their website or app a grievance redressal system for responding to Data Principal grievances within ninety days.
checkable_test: Check if the document provides a prominently published grievance redressal system with a ninety-day response period.
applicability: Applicable to all Data Fiduciaries and Consent Managers under the DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation to publish a grievance redressal system with a specified response period.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must meet requirements specified by the Central Government for transferring personal data outside the territory of India.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies that Data Fiduciaries must meet Central Government requirements for cross-border data transfers.
applicability: Applicable to all Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation to meet Central Government requirements for cross-border data transfers.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must ensure that personal data transferred outside the territory of India is subject to the restrictions specified by the Central Government.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies that Data Fiduciaries must ensure compliance with Central Government restrictions on cross-border data transfers.
applicability: Applicable to all Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation to ensure compliance with Central Government restrictions on cross-border data transfers.

requirement: Data fiduciaries must provide information to the Central Government upon request for purposes specified in the Seventh Schedule.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies procedures for providing information to the Central Government upon request.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries and intermediaries.
notes: This obligation applies when the Central Government requests information for specified purposes.

requirement: Disclosure of information requested by the Central Government may be restricted if it affects India's sovereignty, integrity, or security.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies conditions under which information disclosure to the Central Government is restricted.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries and intermediaries.
notes: This obligation applies when disclosure of information may prejudice India's sovereignty, integrity, or security.

requirement: The term 'intermediary' is defined in accordance with the Information Technology Act, 2000.
checkable_test: Check if the document defines 'intermediary' in accordance with the Information Technology Act, 2000.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries and intermediaries.
notes: This defines the term 'intermediary' for the purposes of the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: Consent Managers must ensure that their platform enables Data Principals to give, manage, review, and withdraw consent in accordance with published data protection standards.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies that the platform enables Data Principals to give, manage, review, and withdraw consent in accordance with published standards.
applicability: Applicable to Consent Managers.
notes: This obligation ensures that Consent Managers align with published data protection standards.

requirement: Consent Managers must enable Data Principals to give consent to the processing of their personal data by a Data Fiduciary onboarded onto the platform.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies that the platform enables Data Principals to give consent to the processing of their personal data by a Data Fiduciary.
applicability: Applicable to Consent Managers.
notes: This obligation ensures that Consent Managers facilitate consent for data processing.

requirement: Consent Managers must enable Data Principals to give consent to the processing of their personal data by a Data Fiduciary through another Data Fiduciary onboarded onto the platform.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies that the platform enables Data Principals to give consent through another Data Fiduciary.
applicability: Applicable to Consent Managers.
notes: This obligation ensures that Consent Managers support indirect consent through other Data Fiduciaries.

requirement: The Consent Manager must enable individuals to give, manage, review, and withdraw their consent for the processing of their personal data.
checkable_test: Verify if the platform provides functionality for users to give, manage, review, and withdraw consent.
applicability: All users of the platform

requirement: The Consent Manager must maintain a record of consents given, denied, or withdrawn by the Data Principal.
checkable_test: Verify if the platform maintains a record of consents given, denied, or withdrawn by users.
applicability: All users of the platform

requirement: The Consent Manager must maintain a record of notices preceding or accompanying requests for consent.
checkable_test: Verify if the platform maintains a record of notices related to consent requests.
applicability: All users of the platform

requirement: The Consent Manager must maintain a record of the sharing of personal data with a transferee Data Fiduciary.
checkable_test: Verify if the platform maintains a record of data sharing with third-party Data Fiduciaries.
applicability: All users of the platform

requirement: The Consent Manager must provide the Data Principal with access to the record of consents, notices, and data sharing.
checkable_test: Verify if the platform provides users with access to the records of consents, notices, and data sharing.
applicability: All users of the platform

requirement: The Consent Manager must maintain the record of consent for at least seven years, or for a longer period agreed upon with the Data Principal or required by law.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies a minimum retention period of seven years or longer as agreed with the Data Principal or required by law.
applicability: Applies to all Consent Managers under the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: The Consent Manager must take reasonable security safeguards to prevent personal data breaches.
checkable_test: Check if the document outlines specific security measures to prevent personal data breaches.
applicability: Applies to all Consent Managers under the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: The Consent Manager must provide the Data Principal with access to the information contained in the consent record in machine-readable form upon request.
checkable_test: Check if the document allows the Data Principal to access the consent record in machine-readable format upon request.
applicability: Applies to all Consent Managers under the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: The Consent Manager must act in a fiduciary capacity in relation to the Data Principal.
checkable_test: Check if the document states that the Consent Manager must act in a fiduciary capacity towards the Data Principal.
applicability: Applies to all Consent Managers under the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: The Consent Manager must not sub-contract or assign the performance of any of its obligations under the Act and these rules.
checkable_test: Check if the document prohibits the sub-contracting or assignment of obligations by the Consent Manager.
applicability: Applies to all Consent Managers under the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: The Consent Manager must have measures in place to ensure that no conflict of interest arises due to its directors, key managerial personnel, and senior management having financial interests or relationships with Data Fiduciaries.
checkable_test: Check if the document outlines measures to prevent conflicts of interest arising from the financial or personal relationships of the Consent Manager's personnel with Data Fiduciaries.
applicability: Applies to all Consent Managers under the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: The Consent Manager must develop and maintain a website or app as the primary means through which a Data Principal may access its services.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies a primary website or app for the Data Principal to access services and manage consent.
applicability: Applies to all Consent Managers under the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: The Consent Manager must avoid conflicts of interest with Data Fiduciaries, including their promoters and key managerial personnel.
checkable_test: Check if the document prohibits conflicts of interest between the Consent Manager and Data Fiduciaries, including their promoters and key personnel.
applicability: Applies to all Consent Managers under the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: The Consent Manager must publish information regarding every person who holds shares in excess of two per cent. of the shareholding of the company registered as Consent Manager.
checkable_test: Check if the document publishes information about shareholders holding more than two per cent. of the shareholding of the Consent Manager.
applicability: Applies to all Consent Managers under the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: Implement reasonable security safeguards to prevent personal data breaches and protect personal data in the possession or under control of the Data Fiduciary.
checkable_test: Verify if the document specifies the implementation of reasonable security safeguards to prevent personal data breaches.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries processing personal data.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation under DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 1214.

requirement: Retain personal data only for the period necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected or for compliance with legal obligations.
checkable_test: Verify if the document specifies the retention of personal data only for the period necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected or for compliance with legal obligations.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries processing personal data.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation under DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 1213.

requirement: Provide a clear communication link for Data Principals to exercise their rights under the Act, including access to the website or app of the Data Fiduciary.
checkable_test: Verify if the document provides a clear communication link for Data Principals to exercise their rights under the Act, including access to the website or app of the Data Fiduciary.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries processing personal data.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation under DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 1217.

requirement: Ensure that the processing of personal data is carried out in a manner consistent with applicable policies and legal standards issued by the Central Government.
checkable_test: Verify if the document ensures that the processing of personal data is carried out in a manner consistent with applicable policies and legal standards issued by the Central Government.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries processing personal data.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation under DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 1218.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries who are e-commerce entities with not less than two crore registered users in India must enable Data Principals to access virtual tokens issued by or on behalf of the Data Fiduciary, stored on their digital platform, and usable for obtaining money, goods, or services.
checkable_test: Check if the e-commerce entity provides access to virtual tokens as described.
applicability: Applies to e-commerce entities with two crore registered users in India.
notes: This obligation is tied to the specific class of data fiduciaries and their responsibilities under the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: Processing of personal data related to children's health is restricted to the extent necessary for the protection of their health by establishments or professionals providing health services.
checkable_test: Check if health-related data processing is limited to what is necessary for the child's health.
applicability: Applies to entities providing health services to children.
notes: This obligation is tied to the specific class of data fiduciaries and their responsibilities under the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must ensure that any information, service, or advertisement likely to cause detrimental effects on a child's well-being is not accessible to the child.
checkable_test: Check if the document restricts access to harmful content for children.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries handling children's data.
notes: This requirement is tied to the purpose of protecting children from harmful content.

requirement: Processing of children's data is restricted to the extent necessary to ensure that harmful information, services, or advertisements are not accessible to the child.
checkable_test: Verify if the document limits data processing to prevent access to harmful content for children.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries handling children's data.
notes: This requirement is tied to the purpose of protecting children from harmful content.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must confirm that the Data Principal is not a child and observe due diligence under rule 10.
checkable_test: Check if the document requires verification of the Data Principal's age and due diligence for children.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries handling children's data.
notes: This requirement is tied to the purpose of protecting children from harmful content.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary who is an individual entrusted with infants and children in a crèche or child day care centre must restrict processing to tracking and behavioural monitoring.
checkable_test: Verify if the document limits data processing to tracking and behavioural monitoring for crèche or child day care centres.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries handling children's data.
notes: This requirement is tied to the purpose of protecting children's data in specific contexts.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary engaged by an educational institution, crèche, or child care centre for transporting children must restrict processing to tracking and behavioural monitoring.
checkable_test: Check if the document limits data processing to tracking and behavioural monitoring for transportation of children.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries handling children's data.
notes: This requirement is tied to the purpose of protecting children's data in specific contexts.

requirement: Data must be retained only for as long as necessary for the purpose for which it was collected, and must be erased or anonymized when no longer needed.
checkable_test: Verify if the document specifies data retention periods and procedures for erasure or anonymization.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries handling personal data.
notes: This requirement is derived from the obligation to retain data only for the purpose of fulfilling legal obligations under the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: Data fiduciaries must ensure that personal data is used only in the interest of sovereignty, integrity, or security of the State, as mandated by law.
checkable_test: Check if the document states that personal data is used only for purposes aligned with national security or sovereignty.
applicability: Applicable to significant data fiduciaries handling personal data.
notes: This requirement is tied to the legal obligation under the DPDP Rules 2025 to use personal data only for specific national interests.

requirement: Data Fiduciary must provide a notice to Data Principal that is presented and understandable independently of any other information.
checkable_test: Check if the notice is presented independently of other information.
applicability: All data fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement ensures clarity and transparency in data processing.

requirement: Data Fiduciary must provide an itemised description of personal data processed.
checkable_test: Verify if the notice includes an itemised description of personal data.
applicability: All data fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement ensures transparency in the scope of data processing.

requirement: Data Fiduciary must specify the purpose or purposes of processing and provide a specific description of the goods or services to be provided or uses to be enabled by such processing.
checkable_test: Check if the notice specifies the purpose and provides a specific description of goods or services.
applicability: All data fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement ensures clarity on the purpose of data processing.

requirement: The Data Fiduciary must provide a mechanism for Data Principals to exercise their rights under the Act.
checkable_test: Existence of a mechanism for Data Principals to exercise their rights.
applicability: All Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation to provide means for Data Principals to exercise their rights.

requirement: The Board may inquire into the fulfillment of conditions set out in Part A of First Schedule before deciding on an application.
checkable_test: Existence of a process for the Board to inquire into fulfillment of conditions.
applicability: All Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement outlines the process for the Board to evaluate applications.

requirement: The reference to any subsidy, benefit, service, certificate, licence or permit provided or issued using public funds shall be construed as a reference to provision or issuance of such subsidy, benefit, service, certificate, licence or permit by incurring expenditure on the same from, or with accrual of receipts to, public funds.
checkable_test: Existence of a definition for references to subsidies, benefits, etc. provided using public funds.
applicability: All Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement defines the scope of references to subsidies, benefits, etc. provided using public funds.

requirement: The term 'computer resource' shall have the same meaning as assigned to it in the Information Technology Act, 2000.
checkable_test: Existence of a definition for 'computer resource' aligned with the Information Technology Act, 2000.
applicability: All Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement defines 'computer resource' in alignment with the Information Technology Act, 2000.

requirement: The Data Fiduciary must implement and disclose measures to mitigate risk.
checkable_test: Existence of a mechanism for the Data Fiduciary to implement and disclose risk mitigation measures.
applicability: All Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement outlines the obligation to implement and disclose risk mitigation measures.

requirement: The Data Fiduciary must provide business contact information of a person who can respond to queries from Data Principals.
checkable_test: Existence of a mechanism for the Data Fiduciary to provide contact information for responding to queries.
applicability: All Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement outlines the obligation to provide contact information for responding to queries from Data Principals.

requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must provide a report regarding the intimations given to affected data principals.
checkable_test: A report must be provided regarding intimations given to affected data principals.
applicability: When a data fiduciary has provided intimations to affected data principals.
notes: This obligation is specific to the requirement of reporting intimations given to affected data principals.

requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must describe measures implemented or proposed to mitigate risk.
checkable_test: A description of measures implemented or proposed to mitigate risk must be provided.
applicability: When a data fiduciary has implemented or proposed measures to mitigate risk.
notes: This obligation requires a description of risk mitigation measures.

requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must describe other means, if any, using which such data principal may exercise rights.
checkable_test: A description of other means, if any, using which a data principal may exercise rights must be provided.
applicability: When a data principal may exercise rights through other means.
notes: This obligation covers the description of alternative means for data principals to exercise their rights.

requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must define the term 'designated authority' as an authority designated under section 15 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.
checkable_test: The term 'designated authority' must be defined as an authority designated under section 15 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.
applicability: When the term 'designated authority' is used in the context of persons with disabilities.
notes: This obligation requires a specific definition of 'designated authority'.

requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must apply the provisions of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and its rules to individuals with long-term impairments who are unable to take legally binding decisions.
checkable_test: The provisions of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and its rules must be applied to individuals with long-term impairments who are unable to take legally binding decisions.
applicability: When dealing with individuals with long-term impairments who are unable to take legally binding decisions.
notes: This obligation requires the application of specific legal provisions to vulnerable individuals.

requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must apply the provisions of the National Trust Act, 1999 and its rules to individuals suffering from autism, cerebral palsy, mental retardation, or severe multiple disabilities.
checkable_test: The provisions of the National Trust Act, 1999 and its rules must be applied to individuals suffering from autism, cerebral palsy, mental retardation, or severe multiple disabilities.
applicability: When dealing with individuals suffering from specified disabilities.
notes: This obligation requires the application of specific legal provisions to individuals with specified disabilities.

requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must define the term 'local level committee' as a committee constituted under section 13 of the relevant Act.
checkable_test: The term 'local level committee' must be defined as a committee constituted under section 13 of the relevant Act.
applicability: When the term 'local level committee' is used in the context of persons with disabilities.
notes: This obligation requires a specific definition of 'local level committee'.

requirement: A Consent Manager must operate in the interests of Data Principals.
checkable_test: Verify that the Consent Manager's operations are explicitly stated to be in the interests of Data Principals.
applicability: Applicable to Consent Managers seeking registration.
notes: This requirement ensures that the Consent Manager's operations align with the interests of data principals, as mandated by the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: The Consent Manager must adhere to its obligations under the DPDP Act and these rules.
checkable_test: Verify that the Consent Manager's policies and practices align with the obligations under the DPDP Act and these rules.
applicability: Applicable to all Consent Managers registered under the DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This obligation requires the Consent Manager to ensure compliance with both the DPDP Act and the Rules, which includes maintaining appropriate safeguards and fulfilling registration conditions.

requirement: The Consent Manager must implement technical and organisational controls, systems, procedures, and safeguards.
checkable_test: Verify that the Consent Manager has documented and implemented technical and organisational controls, systems, procedures, and safeguards.
applicability: Applicable to all Consent Managers registered under the DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This obligation requires the Consent Manager to maintain a robust framework of security measures to protect personal data.

requirement: The Consent Manager must continue to fulfill the conditions of registration.
checkable_test: Verify that the Consent Manager maintains compliance with the conditions of registration as specified in the DPDP Rules 2025.
applicability: Applicable to all Consent Managers registered under the DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This obligation requires the Consent Manager to ensure ongoing compliance with the registration conditions, which may include maintaining data protection standards and operational integrity.

requirement: Data fiduciaries must ensure that processing of personal data is limited to what is necessary for the purposes specified in the law.
checkable_test: Check if the data processing is limited to necessary data for specified purposes.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries processing personal data under the DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: Clause references the necessity of data minimization for specified purposes.

requirement: Data fiduciaries must ensure the completeness, accuracy, and consistency of personal data during processing.
checkable_test: Verify that data processing includes measures to maintain data completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries processing personal data under the DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: Clause mandates data quality standards during processing.

requirement: Data fiduciaries must provide the Data Principal with business contact information of a representative to address questions about data processing.
checkable_test: Check if the data fiduciary provides contact details for addressing Data Principal inquiries.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries processing personal data under the DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: Clause requires transparency and accessibility for Data Principal inquiries.

requirement: Data fiduciaries must ensure accountability for the purpose and means of personal data processing.
checkable_test: Verify that the data fiduciary establishes accountability for processing purposes and methods.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries processing personal data under the DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: Clause mandates accountability for data processing decisions.

requirement: Data fiduciaries must provide the Data Principal with intimation regarding processing under specified legal provisions.
checkable_test: Check if the data fiduciary provides notice to the Data Principal about processing under specified legal provisions.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries processing personal data under the DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: Clause requires notification of processing under specific legal provisions.

requirement: Data Fiduciary must delete Personal Data no later than three years from the date on which the Data Principal last approached the Data Fiduciary for the performance of the specified purpose or exercise of her rights, or the commencement of the Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025, whichever is latest.
checkable_test: Check if the data retention period is explicitly limited to three years from the last interaction or rule commencement.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries handling personal data under the DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement is tied to the specific retention period outlined in the clause.

requirement: Data Fiduciary must enable the Data Principal to access her user account and any virtual token issued by or on behalf of the Data Fiduciary.
checkable_test: Verify if the Data Principal has access to their account and virtual tokens as per the specified obligations.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries handling personal data under the DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement is tied to the specific access obligations outlined in the clause.

requirement: The term 'e-commerce entity' is defined as any person who owns, operates or manages a digital facility or platform for e-commerce as defined in the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, but does not include a seller offering her goods or services for sale on a marketplace e-commerce entity as defined in the said Act.
checkable_test: Check if the definition of 'e-commerce entity' aligns with the provided clause.
applicability: Applies to entities classified as e-commerce entities under the DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement is tied to the specific definition of 'e-commerce entity' outlined in the clause.

requirement: The term 'online gaming intermediary' is defined as any intermediary who enables the users of its computer resource to access one or more online games.
checkable_test: Verify if the definition of 'online gaming intermediary' matches the provided clause.
applicability: Applies to entities classified as online gaming intermediaries under the DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement is tied to the specific definition of 'online gaming intermediary' outlined in the clause.

requirement: The term 'social media intermediary' is defined as an intermediary as defined in clause (w) of sub-rule (1) of rule 2 of the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021.
checkable_test: Check if the definition of 'social media intermediary' aligns with the provided clause.
applicability: Applies to entities classified as social media intermediaries under the DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement is tied to the specific definition of 'social media intermediary' outlined in the clause.

requirement: The term 'e-commerce entity' includes any person who accesses or avails any computer resource of an e-commerce entity.
checkable_test: Verify if the definition of 'e-commerce entity' includes persons who access or avail computer resources of an e-commerce entity.
applicability: Applies to entities classified as e-commerce entities under the DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement is tied to the specific definition of 'e-commerce entity' outlined in the clause.

requirement: Data processing by educational institutions is restricted to tracking and behavioural monitoring in the interests of safety of children entrusted in their care.
checkable_test: Check if the document restricts data processing by educational institutions to tracking and behavioural monitoring solely for the safety of children in their care.
applicability: Applicable to educational institutions handling children's data.
notes: This requirement is specific to the processing of children's data by educational institutions.

requirement: Data processing by educational institutions is restricted to tracking and behavioural monitoring in the interests of safety of children entrusted in their care.
checkable_test: Check if the document restricts data processing by educational institutions to tracking and behavioural monitoring solely for the safety of children in their care.
applicability: Applicable to educational institutions handling children's data.
notes: This requirement is specific to the processing of children's data by educational institutions.

requirement: Processing of children's location data is restricted to tracking their location in the interests of their safety during travel to and from institutions, crèches, or centres.
checkable_test: Check if the data processing of children's location data is limited to tracking their location for safety during travel to and from specified institutions.
applicability: Applies to data processing involving children's location data for travel purposes.
notes: This clause explicitly restricts the processing of children's location data to specific safety-related purposes.

requirement: Processing of children's real-time location data is restricted to tracking their location in the interest of their safety and protection.
checkable_test: Check if the data processing of children's real-time location data is limited to tracking their location for safety and protection purposes.
applicability: Applies to data processing involving children's real-time location data.
notes: This clause explicitly restricts the processing of children's real-time location data to safety and protection purposes.

requirement: Processing of children's location data is restricted to the extent necessary for determining their real-time location.
checkable_test: Check if the data processing of children's location data is limited to determining their real-time location for safety purposes.
applicability: Applies to data processing involving children's location data for real-time tracking.
notes: This clause explicitly restricts the processing of children's location data to real-time location determination for safety purposes.

requirement: Processing of children's location data is restricted to the extent necessary for creating a user account for communication by email.
checkable_test: Check if the data processing of children's location data is limited to creating a user account for email communication purposes.
applicability: Applies to data processing involving children's location data for email account creation.
notes: This clause explicitly restricts the processing of children's location data to email account creation purposes.

requirement: Processing of children's location data is restricted to the extent necessary for creating a user account for communication by email.
checkable_test: Check if the data processing of children's location data is limited to creating a user account for email communication purposes.
applicability: Applies to data processing involving children's location data for email account creation.
notes: This clause explicitly restricts the processing of children's location data to email account creation purposes.

requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must define and use terms consistently with definitions provided in other statutes.
checkable_test: Verify that terms like 'advertisement', 'allied healthcare professional', 'clinical establishment', 'healthcare professional', 'health services', and 'mental health establishment' are defined in accordance with their statutory definitions.
applicability: Applicable to all significant data fiduciaries.
notes: These definitions are critical for ensuring compliance with other relevant laws and regulations.

requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must ensure that their members are compensated in accordance with specified salary terms.
checkable_test: Verify that non-Chairperson members receive a consolidated salary of rupees four lakh per month without house and car facilities.
applicability: Applicable to all significant data fiduciaries with non-Chairperson members.
notes: This clause outlines specific compensation terms for members of the Board.

requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must apply the same terms and conditions for provident fund contributions as those applicable to other officers and employees of the Board.
checkable_test: Verify that the provident fund terms and conditions for members are consistent with those applicable to other officers and employees of the Board.
applicability: Applicable to all significant data fiduciaries with members subject to provident fund contributions.
notes: This ensures uniformity in financial obligations for all members.

requirement: Data fiduciaries must carry out assessments to notify any Data Fiduciary or class of Data Fiduciaries as Significant Data Fiduciaries.
checkable_test: Whether the organization has a process for assessing and notifying Significant Data Fiduciaries.
applicability: Applicable to all Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the assessment and notification process for Significant Data Fiduciaries.

requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure adherence to standards and frameworks and effective observance of obligations under item 11 of Part B.
checkable_test: Whether the organization has implemented appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure adherence to standards and frameworks and effective observance of obligations under item 11 of Part B.
applicability: Applicable to significant data fiduciaries.
notes: This requirement is based on the obligation to implement appropriate measures to ensure compliance with standards and frameworks.

requirement: Processing of personal data is restricted to the extent necessary for the educational activities of the institution.
checkable_test: Whether the organization restricts data processing to the extent necessary for the educational activities of the institution.
applicability: Applicable to processing for educational activities.
notes: This requirement is based on the restriction of data processing to the extent necessary for educational activities.

requirement: Processing of personal data is restricted to the extent necessary for the exercise, performance or discharge of the purpose.
checkable_test: Whether the organization restricts data processing to the extent necessary for the exercise, performance or discharge of the purpose.
applicability: Applicable to processing for purposes specified in the rules.
notes: This requirement is based on the restriction of data processing to the extent necessary for the exercise, performance or discharge of the purpose.

requirement: Processing of personal data is restricted to the extent necessary for the provision or issuance of services or products.
checkable_test: Whether the organization restricts data processing to the extent necessary for the provision or issuance of services or products.
applicability: Applicable to processing for provision or issuance of services or products.
notes: This requirement is based on the restriction of data processing to the extent necessary for the provision or issuance of services or products.

requirement: Data fiduciaries must process personal data only to the extent necessary for the purpose of confirmation or observance.
checkable_test: Verify that data processing is limited to the minimum necessary for the stated purpose.
applicability: All data processing activities.
notes: This clause imposes a restriction on data processing to ensure it is limited to what is necessary for the intended purpose.

requirement: Data fiduciaries must ensure the absence of conflict of interest in the performance of their functions.
checkable_test: Verify that data fiduciaries have no financial or other interests that could prejudice their functions.
applicability: All data fiduciaries.
notes: This clause requires data fiduciaries to avoid conflicts of interest that could affect their obligations.
